comments.author: Disha Mukherjee
comments.comment:
The missing skill I’d add is data contract design.

For AI systems, a schema change is not just a dashboard bug - it can silently change retrieval quality, eval labels, ranking behavior, and cost. The best DEs I’ve worked with treat embeddings, chunks, metadata, and eval sets as first-class data products, not side effects of the pipeline.

comments.author: Reshma Sriraman
comments.comment: I’d add one thing near the top: learn to turn messy business workflows into testable acceptance criteria before writing code. Most AI projects fail less because the model is weak and more because nobody defined what “good enough to trust in production” means.
